name: Stage 1 stuck rule (frozen before round 1; eval plan amendment a7b336b, R&D ruling 2026-10-10)
thresholds_source: untrained pilot-30 baseline, seeds 0-2 (no sealed data)
measure: thinking tokens (the student's tokenizer), p95 by linear interpolation; seeds 0-2

pooling.1, 2, 7+: pooled p95 of all tiers (not covered by DEV); n 102

rule: An answer is stuck when any of these holds:
(a) thinking tokens > max(the tier's p95 above, 2 x the item's own target thinking tokens in its arm);
(b) the same 8-word span appears 3 or more times in the thinking trace;
Detection is passive: it never interrupts an answer. A stuck answer's trace is kept; others are not.
Applies to training-time questions only (the quiz ledger and rehearsals); never to DEV, sealed or pre-interview sittings.
